summary: Correctly extends PR #14047's simplified-path deconstruct technique to other public expressions (Func, Value, RawSQL, Star, Col, Window, WindowFrame, RowRange, ValueRange) via @deconstructible(path=...). Mechanical, consistent, low-risk change that produces cleaner migration output.

issues.description: Star and Col are internal-ish expressions not part of the public django.db.models namespace in the same way; asserting a path they may not resolve from could be slightly off, but this matches the existing pattern and is harmless for deconstruct output.
